name: tugite
description: Use impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, review-refine, code-review, clarify-it, and test-report with internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors while the parent Codex agent owns planning, QA, and final verification.

interface.shortDescription: Install agents and delegate with parent QA.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for the public workflows impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, review-refine, code-review, clarify-it, and test-report, their internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors. Clarify-it also applies when a user clearly wants step-by-step clarification, and returns the reintegrated current decision model without follow-up actions. Code-review also applies when a user clearly wants a Tugite code-review of a change set, and reports evidence-checked findings without fixing or adjudicating. Test-report also applies when a user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests, and reconstructs them as a verification system without editing, running, or evaluating tests. The parent Codex agent performs parent QA and keeps final quality responsibility.
defaultPrompt: Use $clarify-it when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants step-by-step clarification; return the reintegrated current decision model without editing artifacts, implementing, or starting follow-up actions.

Use $test-report when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants to understand a specified set of tests; reconstruct them as a verification system and report observed gaps without editing, running, or evaluating tests.
Use $plan-agent to draft or refine a free-form planning artifact without starting implementation.
Use $plan-interactive to draft a human-directed planning artifact through gate and fixed review without starting implementation.
Use $review-refine to review an immutable artifact snapshot with bounded rounds and caller-owned acceptance evidence.

Use $code-review when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants a Tugite code-review of a change set; capture an immutable snapshot, route specialist reviewers, and report evidence-checked findings without fixing, adjudicating, or writing to the review target. Do not start during impl-lead or plan-family public workflows.
Use $impl-lead to run bounded Work Unit implementation loops with parent QA.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.
